name: Atoms
description_en:
Atoms is an AI-assisted website and application builder that organizes a request into a brief, agent work, preview and versioned delivery. Its current offering also advertises research and growth tasks, but those roles do not prove that an app has product demand or works correctly in production.

A user can iterate through chat, inspect the app and publish a hosted URL. Building, project sharing, live publication, code export and runtime Cloud & AI charges are different operations with different permissions and plan conditions. This profile follows that build-to-live path using official help documents, without starting a project or connecting an account.
description_zh:
Atoms 是 AI 辅助网站及应用构建器，将请求组织为任务说明、Agent 执行、预览和带版本交付。当前产品也推广研究及增长任务，但这些角色不能证明应用有需求或已能在生产正确运行。

用户可通过对话迭代、检查应用并发布托管地址。构建、项目分享、上线、代码导出及运行 Cloud & AI 费用是不同操作，各有权限与方案条件。本文依官方帮助文档研究构建至上线流程，未创建项目或连接账号。

Earlier third-party feature and price claims are retained only in discovery provenance, not as current product evidence.

sections.title_en: Describe one task, then inspect the delivered version
sections.title_zh: 描述一个任务，再检查交付版本
sections.en: A proposed trial could request a small inventory app with a read-only stock list and one edit flow. The chat guide describes a team leader turning the request into a brief, handing it to a specialist and returning a named Version card. Follow-ups apply changes; queued messages run after the current task. Inspect the resulting data operations, empty state and rejected edit, rather than accepting a completion message as functional evidence. This is a suggested evaluation, not a build performed here.
sections.zh: 建议用小型库存应用试验，包含只读库存列表及一个编辑流程。聊天指南描述团队负责人形成任务说明、交给专家，再返回具名 Version card，后续消息继续改动，排队消息在当前任务后执行。应检查数据操作、空状态及被拒编辑，不能将完成消息视为功能证据。本例只是建议，本次未构建。

sections.title_en: An Issue Report provides a recovery attempt
sections.title_zh: Issue Report 提供修复尝试
sections.en: When a problem is reported, Resolve asks the agent to analyze and attempt a fix; the guide warns that repeated clicks before completion create duplicate tasks. Review the attempt’s result before continuing. It does not establish automatic recovery of every application state or external side effect. Test the smallest failing flow and preserve the relevant version before a broad regeneration. No repair success, reliability rate or exact rollback guarantee was observed in this research.
sections.zh: 出现问题时，Resolve 让 Agent 分析并尝试修复；指南警告完成前重复点击会生成重复任务。应核对修复结果再继续，不能因此确立所有应用状态及外部副作用均自动恢复。可先测试最小失败流程，扩大重生成前保留相关版本。本次未观察修复成功、可靠率或具体回滚保证。

sections.title_en: Preview, sharing and production have different states
sections.title_zh: 预览、分享与生产状态不同
sections.en: Share opens the Atoms project; Publish creates the visitor-facing site. Subsequent editor changes remain in App Viewer until an explicit live update. Atoms Cloud publishing offers Migrate existing data; the guide says leaving it off may require recreating products/content. Review that choice and security findings before release, then test the live URL. Pausing makes a Cloud app unavailable but billing continues. Unpublishing is another state and can release server resources; neither action should be treated as a free data-preserving rollback.
sections.zh: Share 打开 Atoms 项目，Publish 创建访客网站；编辑器后续变化需明确更新才上线。Atoms Cloud 发布提供 Migrate existing data，指南称关闭后可能需重建产品／内容。上线前应检查此选项及安全发现，再测线上地址。暂停使云应用不可用，但仍计费；取消发布另是一种状态，可释放服务器资源，不能将任一操作视为免费、保数据的回滚。

sections.title_en: Exported code and platform access have separate terms
sections.title_zh: 导出代码与平台访问条款不同
sections.en: The sharing guide restricts visibility changes to the project owner. Private mode, hiding Discover presence and ZIP export require Pro. The exact archive contents vary, so verify code/assets and external dependencies before claiming the app can run independently. The terms grant use, modification and distribution of generated code while retaining platform/brand ownership. This is not a complete open-source license inventory for the platform or every generated dependency. Private project access also does not automatically prove a previously published site is offline.
sections.zh: 分享指南将可见性变更限项目所有者，Private、隐藏 Discover 及 ZIP 导出需 Pro。归档内容依项目变化，声称可独立运行前需检查代码／资源及外部依赖。条款授予生成代码的使用、修改及分发，同时保留平台／品牌所有权，但不等于完整平台或全部生成依赖的开源许可清单。项目私有也不能自动证明此前发布站点已下线。

sections.title_en: A connector is only as capable as its granted account
sections.title_zh: 连接器能力取决于授权账号
sections.en: Connectors can provide build context, act on an external service or support the published app. Available actions vary by connector/account/release; connecting is followed by enabling it for the relevant chat. Confirm the target and supported action with a disposable sample. Disconnecting stops future use but does not undo previous writes, and provider-side revocation can be separate. A payment or backend connector label does not establish complete production setup, transaction rollback or that every action is available without additional permissions.
sections.zh: 连接器可提供构建上下文、操作外部服务或支持发布应用，操作依连接器、账号、版本而异，连接后还需在相关聊天启用。应以可丢弃样本确认目标及支持动作。断开只停止后续使用，不撤销此前写入，提供方撤权可能还需另做。支付或后端连接器标签不能证明完成生产配置、事务回滚或所有动作无需额外权限。

sections.title_en: Build credits do not pay for the live app
sections.title_zh: 构建积分不支付线上应用费用
sections.en: Pricing starts Pro at $20/month and Max at $100; the help guide maps those to 100/500 plan credits and 10/100 GB storage. Model, context and task affect credit use. Runtime Cloud & AI charges use another balance; upgrading the build plan does not fund it, and an empty Cloud balance can prevent publish/update. The pricing FAQ and help disagree on monthly downgrade rollover, so expiry is unresolved. Free-credit amounts/caps also require account terms, not an unlimited-free assumption. Confirm actual checkout, renewal and runtime rates.
sections.zh: 定价列 Pro 每月 $20 起、Max $100 起；帮助页对应一百／五百方案积分及 10／100 GB 存储。模型、上下文及任务影响消耗。运行 Cloud & AI 使用另一余额，构建升级不会充值，云余额空可阻止发布／更新。定价 FAQ 与帮助对月付降级结转说法不同，故到期仍未厘清。免费积分／上限也需看账号条款，不能假设无限免费；需核对结算、续费及运行费率。
